paragraphs.source_en: My love: Now we cannot hesitate anymore; One must not mistake the only fitting moment: The balance scale—in your own heart, that side is already heavier; there is no need to weigh everything by lawful measure! You and I— Why does it still require me to bring it up? Once sown, one must carry it through to the end. Life, love, and death— a riddle of three linked rings; Push one, and two more press in behind it. To tell the truth, I do not yearn for this living, this skin, that place is no shackling. To be in love, to be free, to be released— this little blade, perhaps it is the heaven of you and me! Yet if we do not die, we must run—run far, far away; Who could bear patience, stirring up lust and noise in this pigpen? Danger— No need to say it: one must always dare it. If one does not stake everything, can one truly seize it? Look at that star— how fierce the light! Behold this night: so solemn, so clear! Come away, dear— the road ahead is no longer dim. Thanks be to heaven, from this moment we have leaped out of rebirth. Composed in November, 1925.

我的愛：

再不可遲疑；

誤不得

這唯一的時機，

天平秤──

在你自己心裡，

那頭重──

法碼都不用比！

你我的──

那還用著我提？

下了種，

就得完功到底。

生，愛，死──

三連環的迷謎；

拉動一個，

兩個就跟著擠。

老實說，

我不希罕這活，

這皮囊，──

那處不是拘束。

要戀愛，

要自由，要解脫──

這小刀子，

許是你我的天國！

可是不死

就得跑，遠遠的跑；

誰耐煩

在這豬圈裏撈騷？

險──

不用說，總得冒，

不拚命，

那件事拿得著？

看那星，

多勇猛的光明！

看這夜，

多莊嚴，多澄清！

走罷，甜，

前塗不是暗昧；

多謝天，

從此跳出了輪迴！

一九二五年十一月作
